description: Machine authority for the kind/type/class/tier naming axes. Entries are exact-context permissions, never basename allowlists.

axis_rules.kind: Arkret-owned discriminators, routing dimensions, registry families, and reducer/authority-ordered projection dispatch.
axis_rules.type: Exact round-trip fields inherited from an external standard. Arkret-owned classification fields are forbidden on this axis.
axis_rules.class: Finite, unordered, closed classifications that do not select incompatible object shapes.
axis_rules.tier: Finite classifications with a declared strict total order and comparison semantics.

ordered_tier_fields.comparison_semantics: A greater risk_tier requires at least as strict freshness and authorization handling.
Invite quarantine trust increases from low through discovery to high; a higher tier may relax review handling only where the consent policy explicitly permits it.

semantic_axis_declarations.note: signal_class is the closed authorization/delivery rail category (setup / moderation / session) gated by signal_class_denied. signal_kind is the WebRTC signaling message dispatcher. The shared literal `moderation` is a coincidence of wording, not a shared value space: neither axis may be derived from or substituted for the other.
